RUST-02-borrowing-evidence/README.md.content:
# Borrowed Records and Lifetimes

This project converts an owned record parser into a borrowed view. The input
`String` owns the text. A `RecordView<'a>` should contain two `&'a str` fields
that refer into that input, rather than two separately owned `String` fields.

The starter is a working owned baseline. Its `OwnedRecord` intentionally copies
the parsed fields with `to_owned`. The reference implements the borrowed target.
Both produce the same text output; output equality alone cannot establish which
ownership contract an implementation has.

## Record and borrowing contracts

The exact schema is `name=<text>;role=<text>`, in that order, with exactly one
semicolon. Empty fields, spaces, Unicode and `=` inside either value are allowed.
Keys are lowercase and case-sensitive. The parser returns an error for a missing
separator, a different key or an extra field. It returns field values unchanged.

`split_once` and `strip_prefix` return string slices. In the borrowed version,
the input's lifetime bounds both returned fields. The `'_` in the return type
uses the single input reference's elided lifetime. It does not create storage or
extend the input owner. A named lifetime would express the same relationship.

`normalize_ascii(&mut str)` changes ASCII uppercase bytes to lowercase in the
existing input. It leaves other UTF-8 characters unchanged, including `É` and
`ß`, and preserves byte length. It is not Unicode case folding. A shared field
view must have its last use before this exclusive mutation starts. The reference
prints the first view before mutation, then parses a new view afterward.

`longer<'a>(&'a str, &'a str) -> &'a str` returns the longer input by byte length,
choosing the left input on a tie. Both inputs must remain valid for the chosen
common lifetime at the call. The annotation describes a relationship; it cannot
make a local `String` live longer or promise the returned reference is `'static`.

`bump_halves(&mut [u8])` splits at `len / 2`. The left slice adds 1 to each byte;
the right adds 10, using `wrapping_add`. The slices are disjoint. Empty input is
valid, and an odd input places the extra byte in the right slice. Writing through
disjoint slices is different from keeping two ordinary indexing borrows alive.

`owned_result(&str) -> String` deliberately copies one final name. That result
can outlive the input owner. Keep this explicit owned result when ownership must
escape; do not change borrowed parser fields into owned copies to hide the
borrowing requirement. The code does not measure allocations or pointer speed.

## Build and run

Use a native Rust 1.97.1 toolchain with rustfmt and Clippy. The crates use edition
2024 and have no third-party dependencies. From the selected role folder:

```sh
rustc -Vv
cargo -V
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline -- 'name=ÉA;role=ß' empty
cargo clean
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline
```

The default run prints:

```text
shared=ALPHA|ADMIN
normalized=name=alpha;role=admin
selected=alpha
halves=[2, 3, 13, 14]
owned-after-drop=alpha
```

Predict the Unicode and empty-counter run before trying it. Compare UTF-8 byte
lengths when choosing `selected`. Program success is status 0 with empty stderr.
Invalid arguments or non-UTF-8 record arguments use status 64. Invalid record
syntax uses status 65. Both refusals have empty stdout and a specific stderr
message. An empty name and role are valid data, not a syntax refusal.

The Cargo checks cover `src/main.rs`. The independent diagnostic files are
compiled separately. From the same selected role directory:

```sh
mkdir -p evidence
rustfmt --edition 2024 --check diagnostics/*.rs
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/shared-and-mutable.rs -o evidence/shared.rmeta
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/two-mutable.rs -o evidence/two.rmeta
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/escaped-local.rs -o evidence/local.rmeta
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/missing-lifetime.rs -o evidence/lifetime.rmeta
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/last-use-before-mutation.rs -o evidence/last-use
./evidence/last-use
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/split-borrows.rs -o evidence/split
./evidence/split
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/owned-result.rs -o evidence/owned
./evidence/owned
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/related-lifetimes.rs -o evidence/related
./evidence/related
```

The first four compilations intentionally fail, respectively with E0502, E0499,
E0515 and E0106. A rejected source file has no runtime result. Each subsequent
working file demonstrates a specific repair: last use before mutation, disjoint
slices, an owned return value or a valid relationship between input lifetimes.
Neither adding `'static` nor adding a lifetime name allocates or preserves a
local owner's data.

## Core project: borrowed record refactor

Complete CORE, BORROW MAP, PREDICT, CHECKS and LIMITS in `observations.md`.
Replace the starter's `OwnedRecord` with `RecordView<'a>`, use borrowed fields,
and update the parser return type. Remove the two field copies without using
unsafe code, leaks, global storage, `'static` or a cloned input buffer. Preserve
all valid and invalid input behavior and the deliberate `owned_result` contract.

The starter's ownership test establishes its initial independent-field contract.
After refactoring, replace that particular test with a borrowed-view test tied
to a still-live input, while retaining the other six tests. Explain why a test
that reads fields after dropping the input is no longer a valid target behavior.
The reference includes one safe pointer-equality check for the exact field
slices; an address value by itself does not prove a general lifetime contract.

## Required continuation: last use and exclusive mutation

Continue the same saved project and complete MUTATION. Draw the input owner,
both shared field views, their last uses and the later mutable borrow. Move a
field use after normalization in a scratch diagnostic, predict the refusal,
then repair the ordering without copying the fields. Record the compiler's
actual explanation and both standard and empty-field run results.

## Choice: independent selector input

Complete CHOICE. Add a borrowed field selector that returns a field from a
`RecordView` based on a separate `&str` key. Tie the return lifetime to the view's
input data, not to the temporary key string. Support `name`, `role` and an
unknown key, and add tests with a short-lived key and a longer-lived record.
Do not return a newly owned field or keep the key alive unnecessarily.

## Challenge: four compiler boundaries

Complete CHALLENGE. Predict each intentional diagnostic before compiling it.
For each, identify the conflicting accesses or unavailable owner and explain
why its paired fix preserves the intended behavior. Add an odd-length and a
wrapping-value slice test, then compare ordinary indexing with `split_at_mut`.
Do not treat a compiler refusal as a process trace or a performance measurement.

## Completion evidence

Keep the changed source, worksheet, exact commands, actual tool versions, test
names, outputs and statuses together. Passing baseline checks does not complete
the parser refactor, new selector or written reasoning. Compare the reference
only after recording the independent attempt. The Rust borrow rules support
memory safety in this safe code; they do not validate the record schema or its
business meaning automatically.

References: [borrowing](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-02-references-and-borrowing.html),
[lifetimes](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch10-03-lifetime-syntax.html),
[split_at_mut](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/primitive.slice.html#method.split_at_mut),
[split_once](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/primitive.str.html#method.split_once).

RUST-02-borrowing-evidence/solution/obse.content:
# Borrowing reference observations

## CORE
The owned baseline returns an OwnedRecord containing two Strings. The target
returns RecordView<'_> containing two &str fields that point into the input.
split_once and strip_prefix return slices; the target stores those slices
directly. owned_result is a separate deliberate conversion for the final escape.
The independent-field test is replaced because returning a borrowed view cannot
promise that the view survives its input owner. The other six tests remain.

## BORROW MAP
record owns the input String. The first parsed fields are read in shared before
normalize_ascii takes an exclusive mutable reference. Their last use precedes
that mutation. The newly parsed normalized fields borrow the same input after
mutation. longer returns one of those fields. The deliberate name String is
independently owned, so printing it after drop(record) is valid.

## PREDICT
The default output is the five lines in README.md. For name=ÉA;role=ß with empty
counters, shared is ÉA|ß, normalized is name=Éa;role=ß, selected and owned-after-drop
are Éa, and halves is []. Éa is three UTF-8 bytes and ß is two. ASCII A changes;
É does not. Empty fields parse successfully and select the empty left field.
Malformed schema returns status65 with no stdout. Usage and UTF-8 refusals use64.

## CHECKS
Record the actual local tool versions, commands, seven test names, clean-build
results and outputs. These reference predictions do not replace observed results.

## LIMITS
Equal program output does not distinguish owned Strings from input-backed &str
fields. The source signatures and safe slice identity test establish the target
contract. Lifetime names express validity relationships without extending any
owner. The parser has a specific two-field schema; Rust does not validate it.
No allocation count, speedup or complete application safety is inferred.

## MUTATION
Using an input-backed field after normalize_ascii overlaps the shared borrow's
last use with the exclusive borrow and is rejected. Finishing that shared use
first permits mutation and reparsing. An owned baseline field would not express
that same borrowing relation, so compare the refactored code, not a copied field.

## CHOICE
One target signature is fn field_for<'a>(view: &RecordView<'a>, key: &str)
-> Option<&'a str>. The returned field refers to the record input. It does not
refer to either the temporary key's contents or the view struct's own storage.
The three key cases still need implementation and independently recorded tests.

## CHALLENGE
shared-and-mutable rejects overlapping shared and exclusive accesses (E0502).
two-mutable rejects overlapping ordinary mutable indexing borrows (E0499).
escaped-local rejects returning a reference to a local owner (E0515), including
with an unsupported 'static promise. missing-lifetime has two possible borrowed
inputs without an output relationship (E0106). The paired working results are
ALPHA then alpha; [2, 12]; alpha; and student. Record actual diagnostics and
the added slice tests independently. Split slices have non-overlapping ranges.

.github/workflows/rust-borrowing.yml.content:
name: Rust borrowing evidence

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "RUST-02-borrowing-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_borrowing.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-borrowing.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "RUST-02-borrowing-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_borrowing.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-borrowing.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: "1.97.1"
      SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the recorded course toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.97.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Verify owned baseline, borrowed target and compiler refusals
        run: python3 test/verify_rust_borrowing.py --proof output/rust-borrowing/proof.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rust-borrowing-evidence
          path: output/rust-borrowing/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

test/verify_rust_borrowing.py.content:
"""Validate the complete RSS2 owned and borrowed roles and intentional compiler refusals."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import tomllib

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACK=ROOT/'RUST-02-borrowing-evidence'
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--proof',type=Path,required=True)
args=parser.parse_args();args.proof=args.proof.resolve()
assert not args.proof.exists()
assert os.getuid()!=0 and os.uname().sysname=='Linux' and os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
OUT=args.proof.parent;OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
commands=[]

def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def stop(signum,_frame):raise SystemExit(128+signum)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop);signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)

def run(command,cwd,label,expected=0,env=None):
    entry=dict(parentTaskId='rust-borrowing-evidence',parentPid=os.getpid(),command=[os.fsdecode(value) for value in command],cwd=str(cwd),
               startTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),timeoutSeconds=120)
    child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
    entry['pid']=child.pid
    with (OUT/'processes.jsonl').open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry,event='start'))+'\n')
    stdout,stderr=b'',b'';cleanup='owned process exited'
    try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=120)
    except BaseException:
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);stdout,stderr=child.communicate()
        cleanup='owned process group terminated and reaped';raise
    finally:
        with (OUT/'processes.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry,event='end',endTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),exitCode=child.returncode,childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup))+'\n')
        (OUT/(label+'.stdout.txt')).write_bytes(stdout);(OUT/(label+'.stderr.txt')).write_bytes(stderr)
    assert child.returncode==expected,(label,child.returncode,stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
    commands.append(dict(label=label,exitCode=child.returncode,stdoutSha256=sha(stdout),stderrSha256=sha(stderr)))
    return stdout,stderr

source_names=run(['git','ls-files','--','RUST-02-borrowing-evidence','.github/workflows/rust-borrowing.yml','test/verify_rust_borrowing.py'],ROOT,'source-inventory')[0].decode().splitlines()
assert len(source_names)==28 and len(set(source_names))==28
source={name:(ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in source_names}
for name,raw in source.items():
    target=OUT/'source'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(raw)
versions={}
for name,command in [('rustc',['rustc','-Vv']),('cargo',['cargo','-V']),('rustfmt',['rustfmt','--version']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--version'])]:
    versions[name]=run(command,ROOT,'version-'+name)[0].decode()
assert 'release: 1.97.1\n' in versions['rustc']

pairs=[('ALPHA','ADMIN'),('',''),('ÉA','ß'),('Crab🦀','STUDENT'),('A B','  '),('../LOCAL','--FLAG'),('NAME=VALUE','ROLE=VALUE'),('\tX\nY','TEST'),('ALPHA','Bravo')]
state=0x0B022042
for index in range(33):
    fields=[]
    for size in [index,32-index]:
        chars=[]
        for _ in range(size):
            state=(state*1664525+1013904223)%2**32
            value=1+state%127
            chars.append(chr(58 if value==59 else value))
        fields.append(''.join(chars))
    pairs.append(tuple(fields))
labels=['name='+name+';role='+role for name,role in pairs]
assert len(labels)==42

def expected_output(record,empty):
    name,role=record.removeprefix('name=').split(';role=',1)
    table=str.maketrans('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
    left,right=name.translate(table),role.translate(table)
    selected=left if len(left.encode())>=len(right.encode()) else right
    counters=[] if empty else [2,3,13,14]
    return (f'shared={name}|{role}\nnormalized=name={left};role={right}\nselected={selected}\nhalves={counters}\nowned-after-drop={left}\n').encode()

roles=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rust-borrowing-evidence-') as temporary:
    work=Path(temporary)
    for role in ['starter','solution']:
        selected=PACK/role;directory=work/role;shutil.copytree(selected,directory)
        role_out=OUT/role;role_out.mkdir()
        env={**os.environ,'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(work/(role+'-target')),'CARGO_TERM_COLOR':'never'}
        manifest=tomllib.loads((directory/'Cargo.toml').read_text())
        lock=(directory/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()
        assert manifest['package']['edition']=='2024' and 'dependencies' not in manifest
        assert tomllib.loads(lock.decode())['package']==[{'name':'borrowed_record_lab','version':'0.1.0'}]
        run(['cargo','fmt','--all','--check'],directory,role+'-format',env=env)
        diagnostic_paths=sorted(str(p.relative_to(directory)) for p in (directory/'diagnostics').glob('*.rs'))
        assert len(diagnostic_paths)==8
        run(['rustfmt','--edition','2024','--check',*diagnostic_paths],directory,role+'-diagnostic-format',env=env)
        run(['cargo','clippy','--locked','--offline','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'],directory,role+'-clippy',env=env)
        assert b'7 passed; 0 failed' in run(['cargo','test','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-tests',env=env)[0]
        run(['cargo','build','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-build',env=env)
        binary=Path(env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'])/'debug/borrowed_record_lab'
        default=run([str(binary)],directory,role+'-default',env=env)
        assert default==(expected_output('name=ALPHA;role=ADMIN',False),b'')
        for index,label in enumerate(labels):
            for mode in ['full','empty']:
                stdout,stderr=run([str(binary),label,mode],directory,f'{role}-input-{index}-{mode}',env=env)
                assert stdout==expected_output(label,mode=='empty') and not stderr
        for suffix,arguments,message in [
            ('bad-mode',['label','other'],b'usage: borrowed_record_lab [record [full|empty]]\n'),
            ('extra',['label','full','extra'],b'usage: borrowed_record_lab [record [full|empty]]\n'),
            ('invalid-utf8',[b'\xff'],b'record must be valid UTF-8\n')]:
            command=([os.fsencode(binary),*arguments] if suffix=='invalid-utf8' else [str(binary),*arguments])
            stdout,stderr=run(command,directory,role+'-'+suffix,expected=64,env=env)
            assert not stdout and stderr==message
        for index,record in enumerate(['name=alpha','name=alpha;group=admin','name=a;role=b;extra=c','NAME=a;role=b']):
            stdout,stderr=run([str(binary),record],directory,f'{role}-schema-{index}',expected=65,env=env)
            assert not stdout and stderr==b'expected name=<text>;role=<text> with exactly two fields\n'
        for name,code in [('shared-and-mutable','E0502'),('two-mutable','E0499'),('escaped-local','E0515'),('missing-lifetime','E0106')]:
            target=role_out/(name+'.rmeta')
            stdout,stderr=run(['rustc','--edition=2024','--emit=metadata','diagnostics/'+name+'.rs','-o',str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name,expected=1,env=env)
            assert not stdout and code.encode() in stderr and not target.exists()
        fixed_hashes={}
        for name,output in [('last-use-before-mutation',b'ALPHA\nalpha\n'),('split-borrows',b'[2, 12]\n'),('owned-result',b'alpha\n'),('related-lifetimes',b'student\n')]:
            target=role_out/name
            run(['rustc','--edition=2024','diagnostics/'+name+'.rs','-o',str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name+'-build',env=env)
            assert run([str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name+'-run',env=env)==(output,b'')
            fixed_hashes[name]=sha(target.read_bytes())
        run(['cargo','clean'],directory,role+'-clean',env=env);assert not binary.exists()
        assert b'7 passed; 0 failed' in run(['cargo','test','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-clean-tests',env=env)[0]
        run(['cargo','build','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-clean-build',env=env)
        assert run([str(binary)],directory,role+'-clean-default',env=env)==default
        assert (directory/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()==lock
        assert all(p.read_bytes()==(selected/p.relative_to(directory)).read_bytes() for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        shutil.copyfile(binary,role_out/'borrowed_record_lab')
        roles.append(dict(role=role,inputCases=84,unitTests=7,unitTestsBeforeAndAfterClean=True,sourceAndLockUnchanged=True,
                          sourceRoleGoal='owned baseline' if role=='starter' else 'borrowed target',
                          compilerRefusals={'shared-and-mutable':'E0502','two-mutable':'E0499','escaped-local':'E0515','missing-lifetime':'E0106'},
                          fixedExecutableSha256=fixed_hashes,executableSha256=sha(binary.read_bytes())))
assert not work.exists() and all((ROOT/name).read_bytes()==raw for name,raw in source.items())
assert len(commands)==231,len(commands)
proof=dict(sourceRevision=os.environ.get('SOURCE_REVISION'),sourceFiles={n:sha(r) for n,r in source.items()},
           compilerVersions=versions,commands=commands,roles=roles,nativeExecuted=True,ordinaryUser=True,
           allSourceFilesUnchanged=True,temporarySourceCleanup=True,externalDependencyDownloadsDuringChecks=False,
           worksheetCompletionNotInferred=True,allocationOrTimingClaimsNotInferred=True)
args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(sourceFiles=28,commands=len(commands),inputCases=168,compilerRefusals=8,fixedPrograms=8,temporarySourceCleanup=True)))
